core_obligations: Reduce to testing surjectivity and etaleness of T x_{U/R} U -> T after base change (proof lines 1658-1668).
Identify the base change with T_i x_{a_i, U, t} R and use that t is etale and surjective (proof lines 1669-1675).
Invoke fpqc locality on the base to conclude (proof lines 1676-1679).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an etale equivalence relation j = (s, t) : R -> U x_S U on a scheme U over S whose quotient U/R is an algebraic space, the map U -> U/R is etale and surjective, so that (U, R, U -> U/R) is a presentation (source lines 1647-1656). The proof tests the map after base change along an arbitrary T -> U/R, rewrites the fppf description of such a morphism to identify T x_{U/R} U with T_i x_{a_i, U, t} R over a covering, and concludes by fpqc locality of surjectivity and etaleness.
